## Runs 6–7 — field spot checks before plan step 4

Completed data/6 (electron) and data/7 (hole) had not yet been promoted at handoff. Each panel below starts with raw voltage/current, then signed V/I and exploratory FFT/onset diagnostics; no absolute-value rectification is used for the FFT. Gate coordinates use run 5's empirical slope and offsets but retain its geometry-prior absolute scale.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset

for rid in (6, 7):
    r = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    channels = resolve_channels(r.meta)
    ci = current_channel(channels)
    cv = next(c for c in channels if c.cid == 'sr1')
    I = r.col(ci.col) / ci.gain
    R = r.col(cv.col) / cv.gain / I
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    order = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[order], R[order]
    print(f'RUN {rid}: {r.rows} points; interrupted={r.interrupted}; wall={(r.meta["end_time"]-r.meta["start_time"])/60:.2f} min')
    print(f'R signed {R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} Ohm; I {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; T {r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K')
    print('max |gate currents| pA:', [np.max(np.abs(r.col(c)))*1e12 for c in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr')])
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 9))
    ax[0,0].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), r.col(cv.col)*1e6); ax[0,0].set_ylabel('Raw sr1 X (uV)')
    ax[0,1].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), r.col(ci.col)*1e3); ax[0,1].set_ylabel('Raw sr0 X (mV)')
    ax[1,0].plot(B, R); ax[1,0].set_ylabel('Signed V / measured I (Ohm)')
    for c in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr'):
        ax[1,1].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),r.col(c)*1e12,label=c)
    ax[1,1].legend(fontsize=7); ax[1,1].set_ylabel('Gate current (pA)')
    for lo in (1.5, 2.0, 3.0):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:,None], B, b_range=(lo,10), nfft=2048, log=False)
        sp=spec[0]; mask=(f>=3)&(f<=65)
        pk,_=find_peaks(sp)
        pk=[p for p in pk if 3<=f[p]<=65]
        top=sorted(pk,key=lambda p:sp[p],reverse=True)[:5]
        print(f'  FFT {lo}..10 T: resolution {1/(1/lo-1/10):.2f} T; peaks', [(round(f[p],2),round(sp[p]/sp[mask].max(),3)) for p in top])
        ax[2,0].plot(f[mask],sp[mask]/sp[mask].max(),label=f'{lo}..10 T')
    ax[2,0].legend(); ax[2,0].set_xlabel('F (T)'); ax[2,0].set_ylabel('Normalized linear-R FFT')
    try:
        onset=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
        print(onset.summary())
        for tone in onset.tones:
            ax[2,1].plot(tone.b_centers,tone.snr,label=f'{tone.freq:.1f} T')
        ax[2,1].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':'); ax[2,1].legend(fontsize=7)
    except ValueError as exc:
        print('Onset unresolved:',exc)
    ax[2,1].set_ylabel('Tone SNR'); ax[2,1].set_xlabel('B (T)')
    for a in ax[:2].flat: a.set_xlabel('B (T)')
    fig.suptitle(f'Run {rid}: raw first, then signed transport and exploratory SdH analysis')
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_{rid}.png',dpi=120)
    plt.show()

r=open_run('data/5'); dt=np.diff(r.col('time')).reshape(-1)
print('RUN 5 timing: point dt 10/50/90 percentiles',np.quantile(dt,[.1,.5,.9]),'wall min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60)

### Read and fan decision — plan steps 3 → 4

Data/6: 921/921 points in 120.36 min, signed R=-32.95..529.63 Ohm, drain current 9.843..9.935 nA. Data/7: 486/486 in 95.68 min, R=-0.38..586.87 Ohm, current 9.809..9.931 nA. Neither interrupted nor clipped; maximum |TG/BG current| was 123/117 pA (6), 216/120 pA (7); sample T stayed 1.165–1.292 K. The negative electron excursions are retained; without field reversal there is no Hall-admixture separation.

Electron FFT component near 30 T persists across 1.5–10, 2–10 and 3–10 T windows (intrinsic resolution 1.76, 2.50 and 4.29 T). Hole component near 12–13 T likewise persists. Lower-frequency peaks and automatic onset classifications are window dependent; the electron 0.30 T censored onset is driven by low-frequency background structure, not convincing evidence that all observed tones survive there. The ~29.5 T electron component tracks to about 1.91 T; this motivates dense fan coverage from 2 T with sparse lower-field reference rows. Harmonic flags are heuristic, not band assignments.

These runs advance feasibility, not a stacking verdict. Run 5's two neutrality ridges can yield multiple frequency families without multiple occupied bands in a homogeneous region, and its absolute capacitance is still prior anchored. The next fan follows density evolution and family intercepts on both signs to test these alternatives. Existing B_1–B_2 stacking call remains **cannot tell (weak)** pending that evidence; no separately wired region is available.

## HERA — Landau fan for stacking discrimination (plan step 4)

> **05:23** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: nominal D=0, n=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (111); B=0..10 T (88 rows), base T, Si=0 V, 3 s dwell · **ETA ~16:23** (≈11h)

Runs 6–7 establish measurable structure on both carrier signs: a ~30 T electron component and ~12–13 T hole component survive FFT-window changes (ana 14–16). Their additional peaks cannot distinguish independent bands from harmonics or the two neutrality ridges in run 5. This fan follows the families versus gate coordinate at nominal ridge-A D≈0, looking for distinct slopes, intercepts and crossings; neither a second FFT peak nor a resistance gap alone will be treated as a stacking identification. Only B_1–B_2 is wired, so any subregion decomposition remains inferential.

The line uses run 5's c_bg/c_tg=0.7728 and offsets; absolute density remains geometry anchored, and D=0 is the resistance-minimum proxy. Sweep n=-1.2..+3.2×10^12 cm^-2 in 111 points (0.04×10^12 spacing), preserving both gate voltages and actual readbacks. Field begins at the handoff's zero and rises through 0,0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,1.75 T, then 81 uniformly spaced inverse-field points over 2–10 T (Δ[1/B]=0.005 T^-1). This gives about 6.7 samples per 30 T cycle and 4.8 density samples per fourfold LL period at 2 T; nominal 2–10 T Fourier resolution is 2.5 T. Higher harmonics or broken-degeneracy structure may require refinement. **Coverage trade:** holes beyond -1.2 are excluded by the D≈0 TG fence; dense B<2 T is omitted because the higher-frequency electron component tracks only to ~1.9 T and the automatic lower onset is background-sensitive. Extending the same dense grid down to 0.75 T would add ~167 rows (~17 hours); sparse low-field rows test whether that is warranted.

Preconditions print and assert live thermometry, base sample/vaporizer temperatures, heaters off, measured B≈0, Si=0, PS/output on, exact committed validators, unchanged gate pacing, provided wiring, 1 V/13.777 Hz drive, NPLC=1, and 0.3 s/24 dB filters. Readbacks from measure 44/46 and operator-run SAFETIES 18 establish the same-kernel gate A/B handoff; live assertions recheck before writes. Acquisition uses 3 s fast dwell (10τ), sr1=100 µV (10 kΩ nominal range) and existing sr0=20 mV. All followed values have live plots, including quadratures, leakage, both temperatures and actual B/gates; no Si ramp, heater change, pacing change or safety edit.

**Timing:** the 10 T traverse costs 10/0.137≈73 min, with blocking field sets. Data/5 measured 1.098 s median point interval at 1 s dwell/NPLC=1; allow 3.20 s per new point including two gate sets and extra readbacks. 9768 points cost 8.68 h; flyback, field settles, row thermometry checks and setup bring the estimate to ~10.3 h before margin. Runs 6/7 took 120.36/95.68 min and support the field-overhead budget. Gates and field stay at the last point after completion; the next segment can descend rather than retraverse.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first 20 points and first complete zero-field row for liveness, baseline shape, clipping and leakage; inspect the first dense rows at 2 T, then approximately every 30 minutes and near 3,5,8 T. The in-cell guard interrupts on |gate current|>1 nA, ≥90% lock-in magnitude range, gross drain-current loss, base-T departure, stale thermometry or readback mismatch. If density-dependent oscillations remain washed out by 5–6 T, stop for analysis before spending the remaining time. The armed hera-watch supplies row digests through completion. On any stop re-read actual state before a move; a kernel interrupt does **not** stop this magnet's already-commanded ramp (rig card), so notify Zack if the supply is still ramping. No automatic return ramp is embedded.

# Plan step 4: Landau fan. Preconditions are read-only; no limit/pacing edits.
for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Si, _ranges = k_si(), (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
print(f'Expected base Ts 1.0..1.5 K, Tv<1.6 K, B=0 +/-0.02 T, Si=0 +/-0.01 V, heaters off; actual {_Ts}, {_Tv}, {_B}, {_Si}, {_ranges}')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and 0 < _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts)<0.6
assert abs(_B)<0.02 and abs(_Si)<0.01 and _ranges==(0,0)
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print('Expected PS/output on:', _ps, _out)
assert _ps and _out
_expected = [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)), (k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
             (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)), (dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
             (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)), (heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
             (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]
for _p, _limits in _expected:
    _actual = (float(_p.vals._min_value), float(_p.vals._max_value))
    print(_p.full_name, 'expected validator', _limits, 'actual', _actual)
    assert _actual == _limits
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP==100.0
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
assert WIRING == {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
                  'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
_pace = (k_tg.volt.step, k_bg.volt.step, dc205.ramp_rate)
_nplc = (k_tg.nplci(), k_bg.nplci())
_drive = (sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency())
_filters = (sr0.time_constant(), sr0.filter_slope(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope())
print('Expected pacing (0.005,0.005,0.5), NPLC (1,1), drive (1 V,13.777 Hz), filters (0.3s,24dB,0.3s,24dB):',_pace,_nplc,_drive,_filters)
assert _pace==(0.005,0.005,0.5) and _nplc==(1,1)
assert abs(_drive[0]-1.0)<1e-6 and abs(_drive[1]-13.777)<0.01
assert _filters==(0.3,24,0.3,24)
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'

# Exact run-5 calibration, SI units. Absolute scale is geometry anchored.
_ct, _cb = 0.0027960593093052633, 0.002160696465377614
_n0, _D0 = -0.08937933224099137e16, -0.013e9
fan_n = np.linspace(-1.2e16, 3.2e16, 111)
_q, _d = cst.e*(fan_n-_n0), 2*cst.epsilon_0*(0.0-_D0)
fan_tg, fan_bg = (_q+_d)/(2*_ct), (_q-_d)/(2*_cb)
fan_B = np.r_[0.,0.5,0.75,1.,1.25,1.5,1.75,field_invB(2.,10.,81)]
assert np.all(np.diff(fan_B)>0) and fan_B[-1]<=B_SESSION_CAP
assert fan_tg.min()>=TG_MIN and fan_tg.max()<=TG_MAX
assert fan_bg.min()>=BG_MIN and fan_bg.max()<=BG_MAX
for _v in fan_tg: k_tg.volt.validate(float(_v))
for _v in fan_bg: k_bg.volt.validate(float(_v))
for _v in fan_B: magnet.field.validate(float(_v))
print(f'Grid {len(fan_B)} x {len(fan_n)} = {len(fan_B)*len(fan_n)}; TG {fan_tg[0]:+.6f}..{fan_tg[-1]:+.6f} V; BG {fan_bg[0]:+.6f}..{fan_bg[-1]:+.6f} V')

# Acquisition range change only; safety validators and all ramp pacing unchanged.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
_sens0, _sens1 = sr0.sensitivity(), sr1.sensitivity()
assert _sens0==0.02 and _sens1==100e-6
_mc = dict(meas_config)
_mc.update({'Si (V)':_Si,'sample_temperature:':_Ts,
    'sr1_gain':1.0,'comments':'landau-fan: B_1-B_2, nominal A D=0; n=-1.2..3.2e12 cm^-2; B=0..10 T ascending; Si=0 V; base T',
    'gate_calibration':{'source_run':5,'c_tg_F_m2':_ct,'c_bg_F_m2':_cb,'n_offset_m2':_n0,'D_offset_V_m':_D0,'absolute_scale':'geometry prior','D_zero':'CNP resistance-minimum proxy'},
    'fan_nominal_n_m2':fan_n.tolist(),'fan_nominal_D_V_m':0.0,
    'lockin_filters':{'sr0_tau_s':_filters[0],'sr0_slope_dB':_filters[1],'sr1_tau_s':_filters[2],'sr1_slope_dB':_filters[3]},
    'sr0_sensitivity':_sens0,'sr1_sensitivity':_sens1})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(_mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B_1-B_2; nominal D=0 V/nm (run5 proxy); n=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2, 111 pts; B sparse 0..1.75 then uniform 1/B 2..10 T,81 rows; TG/BG co-sweep; Si=0 V; dwell=3 s; sr1=100 uV')
# Separate names distinguish actual readbacks from the planned sweep columns.
fan_B_read = qcodes.Parameter('fan_B_read',unit='T',get_cmd=magnet.field)
fan_TG_read = qcodes.Parameter('fan_TG_read',unit='V',get_cmd=k_tg.volt)
fan_BG_read = qcodes.Parameter('fan_BG_read',unit='V',get_cmd=k_bg.volt)
_follow = [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.Y,sr0.P,
           sr1.X,sr1.Y,sr1.P,fan_B_read,fan_TG_read,fan_BG_read,k_si]
for _p in _follow:
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time',_p)

# Column layout: time,B,TG,BG,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,X0,Y0,P0,X1,Y1,P1,Bactual,TGactual,BGactual,Si.
_fan_count = 0
def fan_before(station, writer):
    if _fan_count % len(fan_n)==0:
        try:
            for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        except Exception as exc:
            print('FAN STOP: thermometry freshness',repr(exc))
            station.interrupt_requested=True

def fan_after(station, data):
    global _fan_count
    _fan_count += 1
    a=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    problems=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(a)): problems.append('nonfinite readback')
    if max(abs(a[6]),abs(a[7]))>1e-9: problems.append('gate leakage >1 nA')
    if not (1.0<=a[4]<=1.5 and 0<a[5]<1.6 and abs(a[4]-a[5])<0.6): problems.append('temperature outside base window')
    if abs(a[14]-a[1])>0.02: problems.append('field readback mismatch >20 mT')
    if abs(a[15]-a[2])>0.003 or abs(a[16]-a[3])>0.003 or abs(a[17])>0.01: problems.append('gate readback mismatch')
    if np.hypot(a[8],a[9])>=0.9*_sens0 or np.hypot(a[11],a[12])>=0.9*_sens1: problems.append('lock-in magnitude >=90% full scale')
    if not 5e-9 < a[8]/_mc['sr0_gain'] < 15e-9: problems.append('drain current outside 5..15 nA')
    if _fan_count in (1,20) or _fan_count%len(fan_n)==0:
        print(f'FAN CHECK point {_fan_count}: B={a[14]:.4f} T, Ts={a[4]:.3f} K, I={a[8]/_mc["sr0_gain"]*1e9:.3f} nA, TG/BG={a[15]:.4f}/{a[16]:.4f} V')
    if problems:
        print('FAN STOP:', '; '.join(problems),'point',_fan_count)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_before(fan_before,())
s.register_run_after(fan_after,())
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(fan_bg[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(fan_tg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[fan_B],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],
                          [fan_tg,fan_bg],slow_delay=3.0,fast_delay=3.0)
print('FAN COMPLETE run',fan_result.id,'interrupted',fan_result.metadata.get('interrupted'))
print('Endpoint B,TG,BG,Si,Ts,Tv:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
